issues.description: The action sub-caption prompt text in the lower HUD bar (e.g., '> INJECT A 4TH SERVER SLOT INTO THE LINEAR MODULO ARRAY...') is truncated with an ellipsis ('...') and Node D's inactive telemetry readout in D5 has very low contrast when dimmed at 0%.
issues.concrete_fix: Allow the `.action-prompt` text container to wrap or slightly reduce its font-size/letter-spacing so the full action string fits without `text-overflow: ellipsis`, and raise the minimum opacity of inactive telemetry labels in `.meter-row` to `0.55`.

issues.description: In the final 2.5 seconds (Bars 14-16), the audio track cuts off right as 'Causing' is spoken around 59.77s, compressing the visual transitions for Bars 14, 15, and 16 into less than 2.5 seconds.
issues.concrete_fix: Align Bar 14-16 visual state transitions evenly across the remaining tail or match the exact vocal timestamps if full audio for Bars 14-16 is present.
